package.name: unitree_g1_sdk_bridge
package.description: Bridges ROS2 cmd_vel to the Unitree G1 high-level locomotion controller via unitree_sdk2 (DDS over the robot's wired 192.168.123.x network). Replaces the WebRTC control path -- no AES key / WebRTC handshake required. Safety-gated: the robot does not stand or move until explicitly commanded.
